personality.description: This person tends to explore new ideas privately, often keeping a notebook of thoughts, plans, or observations and refining them carefully before acting. They usually prepare in advance, notice small details, and prefer structured routines, though their high curiosity may lead them to keep revising their plans as they discover better possibilities. In moral dilemmas, they first worry about potential mistakes or consequences, then weigh several perspectives before deciding, and they can become tense or preoccupied if the situation feels ambiguous. In group discussions, they speak selectively and thoughtfully, favoring small, calm settings, and while they are generally cooperative, they will firmly state their view when they believe it is justified.
